definitions.explanation: An automatic machine that dispenses items such as drinks, snacks, or tickets when money is inserted. This is a shortened form of {自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}.

examples.japanese: {自販機|じはんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a drink from the vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{自販機|じはんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電子|でんし}マネー→電子マネー：06694_denshimanee⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This vending machine accepts electronic money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自販機|じはんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界一|せかいいち}→世界一：16531_sekaiichi⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Japan is said to have the most vending machines in the world.

notes:
{自販機|じはんき} is the commonly used abbreviation for ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自販機|じはんき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy from a vending machine)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自販機|じはんき} (drink vending machine)
- {自販機|じはんき}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ (vending machine area)

USAGE:
- Japan is famous for its abundant vending machines
- Available for drinks, snacks, cigarettes, tickets, etc.
- Most accept IC cards like Suica

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧: vending machine (full form)
- ⟦{券売機|けんばいき}→券売機：09553_kenbaiki⟧: ticket machine
